text: Binary per-row measure from the "argument" column (OP's argument text only, current supplied text including marked edits): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, explicitly asserts absolute certainty about their own view, leaving no room for error (e.g. "I am 100% certain", "no possible way I'm wrong", "undeniably true"); 0 for ordinary confident phrasing without explicit absolute-certainty claims, or when no such assertion exists. Ignore quoted others' text or opponents' positions unless the OP adopts them. Exclude as evidence any view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, or text reporting whether the outcome occurred (even within the argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules remains eligible. Do not reconstruct an initial snapshot. Null if the argument is missing or malformed.
